summary: Iteration 33 - Verified Redsys PWA standalone fix in MemberMembership.js. Backend /api/redsys/initiate produces valid production payload for La Fabrika (gym_id=19fdbdcb-...) and a direct curl POST to https://sis.redsys.es/sis/realizarPago with those fields returns HTTP 200 'Pantalla de pago Redsys' (no 'has not been processed' error). Frontend branches validated: when navigator.standalone=true the code uses window.open+document.write and does NOT call form.submit() in the current window; when navigator.standalone=false the code performs the legacy in-place form.submit() to the Redsys URL with the 3 required fields. Stripe/MercadoPago branches remain untouched (still use window.location.href). Everything working as designed.
action_items: Deploy the new build main.73347be3.js to production app.ingresoqr.com (currently serves older main.6e5c98e1.js which likely does NOT contain the standalone fix).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly detects PWA via (display-mode: standalone) match, navigator.standalone, and /pwabuilder/i UA regex. Covers Android TWA PWABuilder (UA token), iOS Safari standalone (navigator.standalone), and installed PWAs on Chrome/Edge.
Popup-block fallback is present: if window.open returns null, code falls back to same-window form.submit() so the user is never stuck.
Stripe and MercadoPago branches are isolated (they use window.location.href via response.data.url) and were NOT modified by this fix — regression surface is minimal.

Minor: inline HTML in formHtml string interpolates redsys_url and the three Ds_* values directly. These values are generated server-side from the official redsys library and base64/HMAC-signed, so XSS risk is practically zero, but if ever user-controlled strings leaked into these fields they would be injected into innerHTML. Acceptable given current source of data.
Order_number is 12 alphanumeric chars as required by Redsys spec; amount is int in cents; merchant_code=181049164, terminal=100, currency=978 all correctly set from gym config.

rca of the issue: User-reported bug: iOS PWABuilder WKWebView POSTs to sis.redsys.es were rejected by Redsys WAF/3DS because the embedded WebView is isolated from the system cookie jar and 3DS redirect chain. Fix: detect standalone/PWA mode and open the auto-submit Redsys form in a new window (via window.open+document.write), which on iOS PWABuilder escapes the WKWebView to the system Safari. Verified both branches behave correctly and the server-generated Redsys form is accepted by production Redsys (no error page).
